question_text: In gRPC / Protocol Buffers, what happens when an older client receives a message containing unknown fields serialized by a newer server in Proto3?

options.text: The client crashes with an UnrecognizedFieldException
The unknown fields are parsed and preserved in the message's unknown fields buffer, retaining them if re-serialized
The entire message payload is discarded
The client sends an automatic rollback RPC to the server

answer_explanation: Since Protobuf 3.5+, unknown fields are preserved during parsing and included in subsequent re-serialization, supporting seamless forwarding proxies without data loss.
reference_solution: Correct Choice: B. Rationale: Since Protobuf 3.5+, unknown fields are preserved during parsing and included in subsequent re-serialization, supporting seamless forwarding proxies without data loss.

criteria.name: Correctness
criteria.description: Selects the exact correct technical option.
